observations: Single photo shows a bare automotive engine assembly removed from a vehicle, sitting on a workshop floor/cart
Visible wiring harness, intake manifold, belts, pulleys, and various sensors
No manufacturer plate, engine code sticker, or model number is legible anywhere in the frame
A watermark reading 'CAMON 40' and camera settings (23mm f/1.8 1/50s ISO233) appear on the image — this is a phone-camera watermark, not an engine brand
No visible oil leaks, cracks, or corrosion from this angle, but engine is seen from only one side/angle
No start-up, compression test, or diagnostic scan shown

identity.kind: used (tokunbo) car engine, make/model not legible

claims.evidence: No import documentation, shipping tag, or origin marking visible in photo 0
No written warranty document or receipt shown
No video or audio of engine running, no compression/diagnostic test result shown

risks.risk: Engine make, model, and displacement cannot be confirmed, which drives most of the price
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/VIN sticker or stamped block number
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all — price depends entirely on correct vehicle application

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal faults (compression, knocking, oil consumption)
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine being started and idling, plus compression test readout

risks.risk: Engine could be missing ancillary parts (turbo, sensors, ECU) needed for installation
risks.proof: Full set of photos from all sides including intake, exhaust manifold side, and connector ends
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete/bare long block only

risks.risk: Hidden leaks, cracked block/head, or flood damage not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos including underside and valve cover removed, plus any flood/rust history
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, worst case damaged

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history of the tokunbo engine is unknown
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or import paperwork showing mileage

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code plate, stamped number, or VIN sticker to confirm make/model
Video of the engine running (cold start preferred) with audio
Photos from all four sides including exhaust side and connector/harness ends
Any import/customs paperwork or dealer receipt showing origin and date
Compression test or diagnostic scanner readout if available
response.reason: The engine's make/model cannot be read from the single photo, and this detail is essential to any meaningful price; a running test and completeness photos are also needed before even a worst-case figure can be set.
